questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following can provide both power and manure?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2015] Which one of the following can provide both power and manure?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) Biogas plants. Biogas refers to a mixture of diff erent gases produced by the breakdown of organic matter in the absence of oxygen. questions.questionTextEn: When was 'Speed Post Service' launched by the Indian Postal Department in competition to the 'Courier service'?
questions.questionTextHi: [State PSC / UPSC PYQ] When was 'Speed Post Service' launched by the Indian Postal Department in competition to the 'Courier service'?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) 1986. The Indian Postal Department started the Speed post Service in August 1986. This Service provides time-bound and express delivery of letters and parcels between specifi ed stations in India. If the speed post is not delivered within the time then the postal department refunds postal charges to the customers. [State PSC / UPSC PYQ]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following is the most important reason for the establishment of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre at Thumba?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 1994] Which one of the following is the most important reason for the establishment of the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre at Thumba?
optionsEn: The sea is near to the place in the east, west and south direction
It is a place near to city in India which is nearest to the geographic equator
It is situated on the geomagnetic equator
Outer space near Thumba exhibits queer atmospheric phenomena
optionsHi: The sea is near to the place in the east, west and south direction
It is a place near to city in India which is nearest to the geographic equator
It is situated on the geomagnetic equator
Outer space near Thumba exhibits queer atmospheric phenomena
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C) It is situated on the geomagnetic equator. Thumba is a suburb of Thiruvanathapuram city, capital of Kerala. Under the leadership of Dr. Vikram A Sarabhai, the Indian National Committee on Space Research (INCOSPAR) decided to establish Thumba Equatorial Rocket launch station (TERLS) at Thumba in 1963. [I.A.S. (Pre) 1994]
